runbookText.source: Payments rollback runbook (PLAT 2720100), version 1, rendered page text and storage format, read 2026-11-13 before the shoot
header: Use during a SEV1 or SEV2 caused by a bad payments release
PAY-6 Safer payments deploys and rollbacks

steps.text: Confirm the current and previous release. The previous revision is the one you are rolling back to.
Run the rollback script from the root of the payments-api repo. ROLLBACK_TIMEOUT is in seconds and defaults to 300. Raise it to 600 if the cluster is under load.
steps.after: The script calls helm rollback payments 0 --wait, so it returns only when the previous release is ready or the timeout expires.

steps.text: Check that the pods are on the previous image tag and passing readiness.
code: kubectl -n payments get pods -l app=payments-api -o wide

steps.text: Watch the charge success rate for 10 minutes. It should be back above 99%.
Freeze deploys: add the deploy-freeze label to the payments-api repo's open release PR and say so in the incident channel.

elsewhere.beforeSteps: If the release also ran a database migration, read Migrations below before step 2. A rollback does not undo schema changes.
elsewhere.warningPanel: Post in the incident channel before you start, and name yourself as the person rolling back. Only one person runs the rollback.
elsewhere.timeoutSection: If a pod is stuck, delete it and let the deployment replace it. Then run step 2 again with a longer timeout.

runbookText.storageStep2:
• Run the rollback script from the root of the payments-api repo. ROLLBACK_TIMEOUT is in seconds and defaults to 300. Raise it to 600 if the cluster is under load.

    bash

    The script calls helm rollback payments 0 --wait, so it returns only when the previous release is ready or the timeout expires.
